title: What You Build Next: Closing Remarks and the Road Ahead
description: We close the day by looking back at what was built, shared and started. That includes highlights from the talks, pull requests opened in the workshop room, and new connections between the open source and decentralized technology communities. The most important part of the day, though, starts after it ends. We'll show you how to keep going: where to find beginner-friendly issues, how to stay in touch with mentors and maintainers, and how to join upcoming FOSSASIA events, including FOSSASIA Summit 2027. We'll finish with thanks to our speakers, volunteers and partners, followed by a group photo. Don't leave without being in it.
